data.rationale: HDFC Bank post-merger integration continues with strong franchise. Loan growth normalizes to 12-14% from elevated post-merger base, slightly above system as market share stabilizes. NIM sustains at 3.9-4.1% leveraging superior CASA franchise and pricing power despite competitive pressures. CASA ratio improves gradually from 43% to 46% as legacy HDFC Ltd wholesale deposits run off and retail franchise deepens. Credit costs remain best-in-class at 0.8-0.9% reflecting robust underwriting and diversified portfolio. Cost-to-income improves to 38-40% through operating leverage and technology investments. ROA expands to 2.1-2.3% and ROE to 17-18% driven by operating efficiency, stable asset quality, and optimal capital deployment. Capital adequacy remains comfortably above regulatory minimums supporting growth and dividends.
